name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Hierarchical navigation trail with links, separators, ellipsis and current-page indicator.
docs: Compose BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbSeparator and BreadcrumbPage inside Breadcrumb. Pass as-child on BreadcrumbLink to wrap a router link component.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BreadcrumbPart } from './parts'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <BreadcrumbPart v-bind="forwarded" :class="cn(attrs.class as ClassValue)">
    <slot />
  </BreadcrumbPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs, type Component } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BreadcrumbLinkPart } from './parts'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type BreadcrumbLinkProps = {
  as?: string | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<BreadcrumbLinkProps>(), {
  as: 'a',
  asChild: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <BreadcrumbLinkPart
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="
      cn(
        'rounded-[6px] text-ink-muted no-underline transition-colors duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-fast)] ease-out-expo hover:text-ink',
        'outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink motion-reduce:transition-none',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <template #render="{ props: rendered }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="rendered"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="rendered"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </BreadcrumbLinkPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BreadcrumbSeparatorPart } from './parts'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <BreadcrumbSeparatorPart
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="
      cn(
        'm-0 inline-flex list-none items-center text-ink-faint select-none [&>svg]:size-3.5',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot>/</slot>
  </BreadcrumbSeparatorPart>
</template>

import { definePrimitive } from '@ui-sdk/core'
import { createParts } from '@ui-sdk/vue/primitive'

const breadcrumb = definePrimitive({
  name: 'p0seid0n-breadcrumb',
  state: () => ({}),
  api: () => ({}),
  slots: (slot) => ({
    root: slot({ attrs: () => ({ 'aria-label': 'Breadcrumb' }) }),
    list: slot({}),
    item: slot({}),
    link: slot({}),
    current: slot({
      attrs: () => ({ role: 'link', 'aria-disabled': 'true', 'aria-current': 'page' }),
    }),
    separator: slot({ attrs: () => ({ role: 'presentation', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }) }),
    ellipsis: slot({ attrs: () => ({ role: 'presentation', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }) }),
  }),
})

export const {
  Root: BreadcrumbPart,
  List: BreadcrumbListPart,
  Item: BreadcrumbItemPart,
  Link: BreadcrumbLinkPart,
  Current: BreadcrumbPagePart,
  Separator: BreadcrumbSeparatorPart,
  Ellipsis: BreadcrumbEllipsisPart,
} = createParts(breadcrumb, {
  root: 'nav',
  list: 'ol',
  item: 'li',
  link: 'a',
  current: 'span',
  separator: 'li',
  ellipsis: 'span',
})

export { default as Breadcrumb } from './Breadcrumb.vue'
export { default as BreadcrumbList } from './BreadcrumbList.vue'
export { default as BreadcrumbItem } from './BreadcrumbItem.vue'
export { default as BreadcrumbLink } from './BreadcrumbLink.vue'
export { default as BreadcrumbPage } from './BreadcrumbPage.vue'
export { default as BreadcrumbSeparator } from './BreadcrumbSeparator.vue'
export { default as BreadcrumbEllipsis } from './BreadcrumbEllipsis.vue'

export type { BreadcrumbLinkProps } from './BreadcrumbLink.vue'
